usedFor: Sales teams use Linked Helper to react to “New Profile From Campaign”, sent when a campaign passes a profile on.

bestTemplate.name: “New Profile From Campaign” in Linked Helper, then “Add Or Update Contact In List” in EmailOctopus
bestTemplate.why: Each profile a campaign passes on can reach a next step as soon as it arrives.

watchOut: Anything that reaches the profile's owner outside your business waits for your approval.
